scope: Consultation request identity and historical receipt recovery

defect.reproduction: Four semantically identical requests, differing only by omitted/empty optional fields after the real HTTP parser, produced four request hashes and a false PostgreSQL identity conflict.

changes: Stable request serialization for new operations, preserving text and meaningful array order.
After a conflict only, bounded service-role read of four identity columns, filtered by owner and operation.
Strict passive snapshot and exact normalized request comparison before the existing resume RPC receives the original historical hash and request.
A conflicting begin recovers read-only and returns created:false, without a second create, claim, provider call or reservation.
No SQL migration, historical hash rewrite, result replacement or production action.

Existing consultation suites
verification.command: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/modelConsultation.test.ts test/modelConsultationStore.test.ts test/modelConsultationStoreSql.test.ts test/consultationHost.test.ts test/consultationIntegration.test.ts test/consultationPersistenceRecovery.test.ts test/consultationTransport.test.ts test/consultationProfileMatrix.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.qualification: Executed after the initial fix, before the sole default-SDK chain correction described below. Existing injected-client paths were unchanged by that correction.

sdkCorrection.detail: The installed Supabase SDK requires abortSignal before maybeSingle. Corrected the default reader order, then passed an actual SDK transport test and full TypeScript.
sdkCorrection.verifiedTransport: Intercepted HTTP only: first conflicting RPC, exact owner-scoped GET with explicit columns, then read-only historical resume RPC. No external requests.

coveredBoundaries: Fresh concurrent equivalent requests retain one reservation
Historical pending and complete records preserve their full SQL row
Real changes to question, model, reflection, speed, reviewers, query or URL remain conflicts
Other owners cannot read or resume the operation
Mis-scoped, incomplete, extended, malformed, accessor-bearing identities are rejected
Reader failure, caller cancellation and stalled lookups fail closed
Custom clients without a reader never fall through to the production database

limitations: FTS extension unavailable; known-symbol impact and context queries used.
The graph does not replace the SQL permission, trigger and regression checks.
PGlite executes production migrations in PostgreSQL/WASM with a serial backend; these cases do not establish native multi-connection lock timing.
The compatibility path uses existing service-role SELECT grants and immutable-identity triggers from migration 032; it has not been deployed against the production database.
The original narrative about 37 pieces/45 EUR versus 23 pieces/27 EUR was not recovered as an exact model trial and is not claimed fixed.
General consultations remain verificationStatus:unverified; completion records execution, not independent proof of every factual answer.
